title: After The Storm
materials: Household rhythm sticks or wooden spoons
quest_mission: Join Vesta & Silas in Terrasol on an acoustic sensory quest to explore After The Storm.
rhythm_ignition: Teacher models a steady 2-minute rhythmic call-and-response beat to 'After The Storm', synchronizing clapping and vocal chanting with the children.
tactile_ritual:
The Hands-On Sensory Discovery:
1. Children gather in a circle with tactile items.
2. Follow the musical cues of After The Storm to touch, sort, and move in rhythmic unison.
3. Pair high-reach movements with deep somatic exhalations.
4. Freeze in quiet stillness at the final chord.

socratic_wonder_circle.rhythm_cue: 65 BPM Sanctuary Rainbow Arc (4-Beat Quiet Pause -> Reflect on Growth)
socratic_wonder_circle.wait_time_rule: Hold a calm 4-beat pause after every question before inviting responses.
prompts: Plausible Inferences (S-32): After a storm passes, what clues on the ground, in the sky, and in the air tell us the storm happened even if we slept through it?
Evaluating Explanations (S-18): Why does a rainbow need BOTH lingering water droplets AND returning sunlight—what does that teach us about hard moments and calm recovery?
Testing Assumptions (S-30): When a stormy feeling (anger, worry, or tears) hits, why is it false to assume the storm will last forever—and what calm tools help our sanctuary reset?

age_tier_scaffolds.Sprouts (Ages 2–4): Trace a slow rainbow arc overhead while taking 3 calm 65 BPM breaths.
age_tier_scaffolds.Pathfinders (Ages 4–5): Spot 3 after-rain clues (wet leaves, puddles, earthworms, fresh air) and explain how rain helped.
age_tier_scaffolds.Wayfarers (Ages 6–7): Synthesize how sunlight + water create rainbows and connect physical weather recovery to emotional resilience.

remodelled_unit_refs: Unit #70: Friendship and Family Relationships (Holistic Thematic Unit) (PDF p.297)

domain_spider.language: Articulate clear auditory phrasing and target vocabulary connected to After The Storm.
domain_spider.cognitive: Identify rhythmic patterns, tempo shifts, and conceptual categories in Terrasol.
domain_spider.physical: Gross motor whole-body balance, bilateral coordination, and fine motor finger rhythm.
domain_spider.science_sensory: Tactile exploration of real-world materials and acoustic auditory pitch discrimination.
domain_spider.social_emotional: Cooperative participation, shared attentional focus, and calming self-regulation.

teacher_whisper: Auditory rhythmic pacing stimulates brainstem regulation and synchronizes attention across the classroom without visual screen fatigue.

standards.kindergarten_readiness: Actively participates in screen-free multi-sensory rhythm rituals and articulates key conceptual observations.
